_doc: The Gap v2 script. Frames in gapDialogue.ts are generated from this + the real voice lengths by scripts/layout-gap.mjs. pause = frames of silence/action before the line.

lines.text: Red alert! Lower left molar is screaming!
WHAT?! ONE tooth?! I chewed for YEARS!
Tell the bone... I loved it!
Patching the hole! Give us a few weeks!
Ooh, a hole! I'm touching it!
Who moves in first? Comment your guess!
I'm not moving. I'm just leaning.
Nobody bites me back... so I'm coming DOWN!
No workout? I shrink up to half!
Lost a tooth? Ask your dentist early!
